title: Abundance after nonvanishing for compact Kähler fourfolds
main_claim: Let (X,Δ) be a normal compact Kähler klt fourfold whose actual adjoint D=K_X+Δ is Q-Cartier and analytically nef. If κ(X,D)≥0, then D is semiample, and when κ=0 some multiple mD is trivial. The proof handles κ≥1 with Höring–Lazić–Lehn. For κ=0 it argues by contradiction: a nonzero section divisor gives a supported nef dlt model (A~P with Supp P=⌊B⌋, κ=0). Floor generation then makes A|_S semiample, and a dimension-free supported lifting theorem forces κ≥1.

issues.description: The case κ≥1 rests entirely on the cited Höring–Lazić–Lehn 2025, Theorem 4.1. The paper says this gives semiampleness for nef klt adjoints on ordinary Q-factorial compact Kähler spaces with positive Iitaka dimension, unconditionally in dimension ≤4. Its exact hypotheses could not be checked offline.
issues.evidence: 'Theorem 4.1 of Höring–Lazić–Lehn states that a nef adjoint of a compact ordinary Q-factorial Kähler klt pair of positive Iitaka dimension is semiample, unconditionally in dimension at most four.'

issues.description: The finiteness of the supported fourfold program, including dlt/factoriality preservation and special termination, is imported from Das–Hacon–Păun 2024 (proof of Theorem 7.2). The paper supplies its own contraction inputs (finite-null, prime-floor extension, outer target positivity). The cited termination argument was not re-verified.
issues.evidence: 'The factorial/dlt preservation and the special-termination argument in [proof of Theorem 7.2, DHP24] apply to the unchanged original boundary.'

issues.description: The finite-order lifting is only partly audited here: the split residue insertion, the filtered SNC Hodge-module lowest piece, and the projective symbol-kernel vanishing were skimmed. This is the same mechanism as the companion Lifting paper, which the rank232 sibling audited with no gap found. The endgame was checked: the periodic-layer Euler-characteristic count and the h^1(O_V) loss.
issues.evidence: Lemma obstruction-derivation, Lemma local-symbol, Corollary symbol-kernel; endgame eqs. (periodic-layers), (thickening-growth).

coverage: Read in full: introduction, completion, reduction (supported preparation, MMP step bookkeeping, discrepancy increase/fiber-support lemma, special resolution, P≠0 via negativity), links (small models, torsion-free lemma via μ_m roots and the L² character, vertical/horizontal restriction, horizontal Mori model, restriction criterion with the even-q residue comparison), scalars (finite isotropy: curves, Moishezon via Fujino–Gongyo, class-link lemma, Lorentz/radical lattice lemma, a(P)=0 and a(P)=1 elliptic cases), gluing (transport of lower restrictions, norm-product induction, generation by hyperplane avoidance), and the lifting endgame. Checked the finite-null contraction and no-null-surface lemma in outline. Only skimmed: conventions, adjunction, the contraction-inputs bridge, covers, hodge, and the all-orders obstruction-vanishing core. Sanity-tested the dimension-free supported lifting theorem on Atiyah's P(F_2) and on Halphen-type blowups of P^2: neither is a counterexample. Nefness also follows automatically from A|_S semiample plus Supp P=S.
sibling_notes: Same family as Lifting (rank232) and Nonvanishing (rank272). This paper reproves the supported lifting theorem internally, using the same cyclic-cover / derivation / Hodge-symbol-kernel mechanism the rank232 sibling verified. It needs no OpenAI companion as input, since the companions are cited only as context. The external dependencies are HLL25 Thm 4.1, DHP24 Thms 5.5/7.2/2.44–2.45, DasOu25 Cor 1.3, and FG14 Thm 1.1.
